# El Nido tour film — production release

## Scope

The owner supplied a Philippines video and identified it as a tour in El Nido.
Added one compact film block to the existing Philippines preview, without changing
the homepage, background videos, public routes or backend integration. The full
written Philippines story remains pending.

Source: 28.19 seconds, 2560 × 1440, H.264, 30 fps, AAC audio, 55,318,146 bytes.
Web derivatives preserve the complete clip and audio, strip source metadata and
use H.264, 30 fps, YUV 4:2:0 and MP4 fast start:

- Desktop: 1920 × 1080, 14,298,524 bytes.
- Mobile: 1280 × 720, 6,471,961 bytes; selected by the existing player at widths up to 700px.
- Preview image: 1280 × 720 WebP, 120,322 bytes, extracted from this supplied clip.

The existing viewport player provides muted autoplay, pausing outside the viewport,
native controls, reduced-motion/data-saver handling and accessible start/retry.
A permanent direct-file link remains available without JavaScript.
